name: frame-studio
description: Frame Studio video-editing style for Claude: Magazine layout: the speaker framed in a rounded panel on a cream page with an editorial headline and serif captions. Use for personal brands, coaches, interviews, thought leadership, LinkedIn video. Turns a raw clip into a finished 9:16 edit with the video-studio-core engine (transcribe, auto-cut, motion graphics, sound, grade).

findings.excerpt: python CORE/scripts/run.py clip.mp4 --style STYLE --work edit-frame-studio --stop-after plan --title "Your headline"
